lines.text: While Jeremiah is confined in the courtyard of the guard, the LORD tells him to call and He will answer.
The Chaldeans are coming to fight, but the LORD promises to bring Jerusalem health and healing.
In Jerusalem's deserted streets, the voices of a bride and bridegroom will be heard again.
The LORD will make a righteous Branch sprout for Saul, and Jerusalem will be called The LORD Our Righteousness.
The LORD says He will multiply David's descendants like the stars of heaven and the grass of the field.
